faq.q: What is Double-Crested Cormorant in GTA 6?
faq.a: Double-Crested Cormorant is an animal listed for GTA 6 on the GTA Fandom wiki. The wiki entry is the only record of it. Rockstar has not named it in a trailer, a press release or on the Grand Theft Auto VI site, so this page records the wiki listing and marks it as a community source.

faq.q: Is Double-Crested Cormorant confirmed for GTA 6?
faq.a: No. A Fandom wiki page is written by fans, not by Rockstar. This site files Double-Crested Cormorant as community identified, at low confidence, for that reason. The entry stays at low confidence until Rockstar or a major outlet names it.

faq.q: What does the wiki say about Double-Crested Cormorant?
faq.a: The wiki gives 3 details. Type: bird. Species: Birds. Listed at: Leonida. Those are wiki fields copied as they stand. No figure here was measured in the game, because the game has not released.

faq.q: Where does this Double-Crested Cormorant information come from?
faq.a: From the GTA Fandom wiki page for Double-Crested Cormorant, collected by the outlawdb project on 2026-09-13 and released under CC BY-SA 3.0. The source link on this page opens the wiki page itself, so you can read the same entry.

faq.q: What is still unknown about Double-Crested Cormorant?
faq.a: Most of it. Double-Crested Cormorant rests on a fan wiki listing and nothing else. Whether the animal can be hunted or killed and where it appears on the map are both unpublished. Rockstar answers questions like this at launch, not before, so this page will change when it does.

faq.q: Will Double-Crested Cormorant be in the finished GTA 6?
faq.a: Not known. A wiki listing is a claim by a fan editor, not a Rockstar statement. Plenty of animal entries written before a launch never appear in the game. This site records the claim and the source, and marks the entry unconfirmed until that changes.
